areaNotes: Plan Phase 11 row (REDESIGN_PLAN.md:288) verified against code: 'bulk/tag-only routes remain unwired' is FALSE — bulk: AuthorProfileView.swift:709 -> :73 -> WritingBulkEditDestination; tag-only: AuthorProfileView.swift:540 swipe and WorkEditView.swift:374-378. 'remaining association/series/preview controls still need wiring' is FALSE for association/series (WorkEditView.swift:244-279, all five rows navigate) and TRUE for preview (AO3WorkActions.previewWork/previewChapter at :365/:375 have no AO3AuthService wrapper and no UI caller; every post sends .postWithoutPreview). Also unwired services: deleteChapter, loadChapterDeleteImplications, saveChapterUpdatingTotal, createSeries (the /series/new path throws seriesCreateUnavailable by design), and form.newSeriesTitle. The §3 audit table rows at REDESIGN_PLAN.md:584 (1u) and :1086-1090 (EditTagsView/1br unreachable, 1bs = WritingDraftsView) are stale. No OWNER_DECISION comments were found on any writing board; departures in code are AO3-ground-truth notes (EditMultipleWorksView gifts/remove_me/three-state switches, EditTagsView at-least-one warning, 'Posts as typed') or ponytail deferrals (1v split). Every save/post/delete on these screens is an AO3 write: buildable, never live-verified.
